description: From the creative mind of Cruel Santino, Subaru Live Radio on NTS explores Nigeria's alternative music scene with rare sounds, global collaborations, exclusive cuts, and special guest features. Set in an immersive underwater theme, each episode brings listeners into Subaru World, building a lasting library of groundbreaking music for future generations.
title: Cruel Santino Presents: Subaru Live Radio
